workloads.name: small-book
workloads.objective: baseline overhead: about 10 levels and 100-200 small orders, a mix of every command

workloads.name: deep-book
workloads.objective: large working set: about 100k resting orders over 2000 levels, inserts and cancels spread over the band

workloads.name: matching-heavy
workloads.objective: matching efficiency: most submissions marketable and medium to large, so they sweep orders

workloads.name: cancellation-heavy
workloads.objective: order index and removal: half the commands cancel an order anywhere in a 50k-order book, none trade

workloads.name: mostly-resting
workloads.objective: insertion and book growth: almost every command rests a new order
